blocks.html: My Story

Hi, my name is Irina, and Fallen Tree Vancouver is the heart of my creative journey.
I was born in Ukraine, grew up in Russia, and for the last decade I’ve called Vancouver home. Surrounded by ocean, forest, and mountains, I found endless inspiration in the natural world - from the tide rolling over shells to the quiet beauty of seasonal blooms.
“The little girl in me would never have believed I'd end up here”

How It Began

My journey as an artist started in 2020 during the pandemic, a time of uncertainty for everyone. I began experimenting with epoxy resin and flower preservation as a way to keep my hands busy and my spirit grounded. What began as a small project soon became my greatest passion.
“In a time of uncertainty, I found the clarity of art”

Why Resin Art

Resin became more than a material for me - it became therapy. Each piece is a way to capture fleeting beauty: a flower that would fade, a shell collected on the shore, the shimmer of the ocean. Through resin, I can preserve those moments forever.
“Resin taught me that nothing truly beautiful is ever lost”

What I Create

Today, I design one-of-a-kind pieces - coasters, trays, lamps, and keepsakes that carry a story. Each artwork holds a memory of the tide, the forest, or a flower, turned into something timeless for your home. My greatest joy is knowing that these pieces bring beauty and connection to others.
“I believe every shell, every petal, and every wave deserves to be remembered.”

Thank You

Thank you for visiting Fallen Tree Vancouver and being part of this journey. Every piece I make carries not only resin and nature, but a part of my heart.

og.description: Preserve flowers and create lasting keepsakes with Fallen Tree Vancouver. Custom flower preservation art including bouquets, memorials, and unique gift pieces.

blocks.html:
Preserve your flowers, keep the memory forever

Wedding bouquets, memorial flowers, and special blooms - transformed into timeless art

How It Works

Our Process:

1. Book your spot - reserve your date with a quick form

  2. Drop off your flowers - bring or ship your bouquet within 2-3 days after the event

  3. Preservation - we carefully dry and cast your blooms in resin

  4. Pickup or delivery - your keepsake is ready in 6-10 weeks
Pricing

Flower preservation prices start at $150 CAD. Prices vary by size, style, and flowers. Heart blocks, trays, coasters and mini lamps/candle holders made with your flowers, custom shapes available.

Booking in advance is recommended as spots are limited.

FAQs

We know flower preservation can feel like a new world. Here are some of the questions we hear most often from our clients. If you don’t see your answer here, just send us a note - we’d love to help.

items.q: When should I book my preservation?
items.a: As soon as you can 🌸 Our spots are limited, so reserving early means we’ll have space ready for your flowers.

items.q: How do I bring or send my flowers?
items.a: If you’re local to Vancouver, you can drop them off within 2-3 days after your event. If you’re outside the city, we’ll guide you on how to safely ship them.
Most blooms look stunning once preserved - roses, peonies, wildflowers, even greenery. Some delicate petals may shift in color a little, but that’s part of their natural charm.
Around 6-10 weeks. We take our time to carefully dry and set your flowers in resin so they’ll last for years to come.
Our most-loved pieces are heart blocks, trays, and coasters, starting at $150 CAD. We also create custom designs if you’re dreaming of something unique.

items.q: Will my flowers look exactly the same as fresh?
items.a: Resin captures their beauty, but shades may deepen or soften slightly. Think of it as a gentle transformation that keeps their spirit alive.

items.q: How do I care for my piece?
items.a: Keep it out of direct sun and heat. Wipe gently with a soft cloth if needed. That’s it - no extra fuss, just enjoy it for years.

blocks.html: Still have questions? Reach out anytime - we’d love to hear from you!
